title: Cluster usage

panels.title: GPUs
panels.description: GPUs in the selection on this rack.

targets.expr: count(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs in use
panels.description: GPUs a process holds memory on (gpu_processes.py, every minute), or, on nodes it can't reach, a Slurm job holds.

targets.expr: count((count by (instance, gpu) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})) or on (instance, gpu) count by (instance, gpu) ((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs free
panels.description: GPUs on nodes the collector sees that no process and no Slurm job holds: unused.

targets.expr: count((DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"} and on (instance) label_replace(gpu_processes_node_up{job="gpu_processes"} == 1, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) unless on (instance, gpu) (count by (instance, gpu) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})) or on (instance, gpu) count by (instance, gpu) ((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs not visible
panels.description: GPUs on nodes the collector can't reach (ssh not allowed: the xcyber partition) that no Slurm job the pusher sees holds: unknown, maybe free.

targets.expr: count((DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"} unless on (instance) label_replace(gpu_processes_node_up{job="gpu_processes"} == 1, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) unless on (instance, gpu) (count by (instance, gpu) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})) or on (instance, gpu) count by (instance, gpu) ((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs held but idle
panels.description: GPUs in use (above) while under 5% busy on average over the last 15 min.

targets.expr: count((avg_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"}[15m]) < 5) and on (instance, gpu) (count by (instance, gpu) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})) or on (instance, gpu) count by (instance, gpu) ((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPU utilisation
panels.description: Average over the rack's selected GPUs of the time a kernel was running (nvidia-smi's utilisation).

targets.expr: avg(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})

panels.title: CPU utilisation
panels.description: Average over the rack's selected nodes' cores of the time not idle, last 5 min.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: CPU memory used
panels.description: The CPU memory only (the NUMA nodes with CPUs): on GB300 nodes the GPUs' memory is system memory too, and counting it would hide CPU memory pressure. Available = free + file cache + reclaimable slab. Nodes the collector can't reach are left out.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - sum(label_replace(node_cpu_memory_available_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance) count by (instance) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})) / sum(label_replace(node_cpu_memory_total_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance) count by (instance) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-01-.*"})))

panels.title: GPUs
panels.description: GPUs in the selection on this rack.

targets.expr: count(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"}) or vector(0)

targets.expr: count((DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"} and on (instance) label_replace(gpu_processes_node_up{job="gpu_processes"} == 1, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) unless on (instance, gpu) (count by (instance, gpu) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"})) or on (instance, gpu) count by (instance, gpu) ((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"})))) or vector(0)

panels.description: GPUs on nodes the collector can't reach (ssh not allowed: the xcyber partition) that no Slurm job the pusher sees holds: unknown, maybe free.

targets.expr: count((DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"} unless on (instance) label_replace(gpu_processes_node_up{job="gpu_processes"} == 1, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) unless on (instance, gpu) (count by (instance, gpu) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"})) or on (instance, gpu) count by (instance, gpu) ((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"})))) or vector(0)

panels.description: GPUs in use (above) while under 5% busy on average over the last 15 min.

targets.expr: count((avg_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"}[15m]) < 5) and on (instance, gpu) (count by (instance, gpu) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"})) or on (instance, gpu) count by (instance, gpu) ((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPU utilisation
panels.description: Average over the rack's selected GPUs of the time a kernel was running (nvidia-smi's utilisation).

targets.expr: avg(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"})

panels.title: CPU utilisation
panels.description: Average over the rack's selected nodes' cores of the time not idle, last 5 min.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: CPU memory used
panels.description: The CPU memory only (the NUMA nodes with CPUs): on GB300 nodes the GPUs' memory is system memory too, and counting it would hide CPU memory pressure. Available = free + file cache + reclaimable slab. Nodes the collector can't reach are left out.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - sum(label_replace(node_cpu_memory_available_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance) count by (instance) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"})) / sum(label_replace(node_cpu_memory_total_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance) count by (instance) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node", instance=~"C2-GB300-02-.*"})))

panels.title: Utilisation, 15-min average (%)
panels.description: Each GPU's utilisation averaged over 15 min. Grey: under 5%, effectively unused.

targets.expr: avg_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"}[15m])

panels.title: Who is on each GPU
panels.description: The user and workload (container, Slurm job's script, or command) holding the most memory on each GPU; on nodes the collector can't reach, the Slurm job holding it (user and job name), else 'not visible'; free: no process and no Slurm job.

targets.expr: topk by (instance, gpu) (1, label_join((label_replace(gpu_process_memory_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"}), "who", " · ", "user", "workload")) or on (instance, gpu) label_join((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"}), "who", " · ", "user", "job_name") or on (instance, gpu) label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"} unless on (instance) label_replace(gpu_processes_node_up{job="gpu_processes"} == 1, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "who", "not visible", "", "") or on (instance, gpu) label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"}, "who", "free", "", "")

panels.title: GPU utilisation by node
panels.description: Average of each node's GPUs.

targets.expr: avg by (instance) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})

panels.title: CPU utilisation by node
panels.description: Cores not idle, 5-min rate.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"}[5m])))

panels.title: CPU memory used by node
panels.description: CPU memory only (see the stat above); nodes the collector can't reach are left out.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - label_replace(node_cpu_memory_available_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") / label_replace(node_cpu_memory_total_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)")) and on (instance) count by (instance) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})

panels.title: GPUs in use, by user
panels.description: GPUs each user's processes hold, stacked; the top is all GPUs in use.

targets.expr: count by (user) (count by (instance, gpu, user) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})) or on (instance, gpu) count by (instance, gpu, user) ((slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"} and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})))

panels.title: Workloads on GPUs now
panels.description: Every process group holding GPU memory, Slurm or not (gpu_processes.py): workload is its Docker container, else its script or command.

targets.expr: count by (user, workload, slurm_job) (count by (instance, gpu, user, workload, slurm_job) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})))

count by (user, workload, slurm_job) (count by (instance, user, workload, slurm_job) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})))

avg by (user, workload, slurm_job) (count by (instance, gpu, user, workload, slurm_job) ((label_replace(gpu_process_count{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})) * 0 + on (instance, gpu) group_left DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL)

sum by (user, workload, slurm_job) ((label_replace(gpu_process_memory_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)") and on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition", instance=~"$node"})) / 2^30

panels.title: Slurm jobs: allocated and used
panels.description: Running Slurm jobs the job pusher's account sees (slurm-exporter): what they were allocated and what they use. GPU memory from the processes on its GPUs; CPU % is busy cores over allocated CPUs; RAM requested is empty for jobs that requested none (the pusher doesn't report RAM in use).

targets.expr: count by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"})
avg by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"})

sum by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (label_replace(gpu_process_memory_bytes{job="gpu_processes"}, "job_id", "$1", "slurm_job", "(.+)") * on (job_id) group_left (user, job_name, partition) group by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_cpus{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"})) / 2^30
max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_cpus{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"})

100 * sum by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[2m]) * on (instance, cpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_cpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"}) / on (job_id, user, job_name, partition) max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_cpus{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"})
max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_memory_bytes{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition"} > 0) / 2^30

panels.title: GPU-hours by user (time range)
panels.description: GPU-hours each user's processes held over the dashboard's time range (recording rule flywheel:user_gpus_in_use, every minute, since 2026-10-15); GPU-hours busy weights them by utilisation.

targets.expr: sum by (user) (sum_over_time(flywheel:user_gpus_in_use{partition=~"$partition"}[$__range])) / 60
sum by (user) (sum_over_time(flywheel:user_gpus_busy_any{partition=~"$partition"}[$__range])) / 60

panels.title: GPU process data age
panels.description: Seconds since gpu_processes.py last pushed (every minute; over ~120 s it has stopped).

targets.expr: time() - max(push_time_seconds{job="gpu_processes"})

panels.title: Slurm job data age
panels.description: Seconds since the Slurm job pusher (exporter.py --push, run by the account that sees every job) last pushed.

targets.expr: time() - max(push_time_seconds{job="slurm_jobs"})

description: GPU, CPU and memory use of the cluster's GPU nodes, which GPUs are unused, and who is using the rest.
